ceo.name: Mark Zuckerberg
ceo.background: Co-founder of Facebook in 2004, dropped out of Harvard to focus on company, became world's youngest self-made billionaire at age 23 in 2008
ceo.track_record: Led Facebook from Harvard dorm room to world's largest social network, navigated through major challenges including Cambridge Analytica scandal, pivot to metaverse (incurred $13.7B losses), strategic pivot to AI in 2023

cfo.name: Susan Li
cfo.background: Joined Meta in 2008, Stanford Economics graduate, previously at Morgan Stanley as investment banking analyst, served as VP of Finance before CFO appointment in November 2022

key_executives.name: Joel Kaplan
key_executives.note: Appointed January 2025 to lead Facebook's global policy, regulatory, and government relations

recent_changes.context: 17-year veteran stepped down amid AI leadership reshuffle
Reported preparation to leave to launch own start-up

compensation_highlights: 2025 executive bonus raised from 75% to 200% of base salary. Mark Zuckerberg receives $1 salary. Shareholders approved 2025 Equity Incentive Plan and voted for triennial advisory votes on executive compensation.

governance_notes: Controlled company structure with majority independent directors. Three standing committees: Audit & Risk Oversight, Compensation/Nominating/Governance, Privacy and Product Compliance. Quarterly board meetings with no term limits.
